§6Petroil§f

§aReclaimed oil plus lubricant, blended into a medium-grade fuel for the diesel generator!§f

Petroil is a custom fuel blend made by mixing §bReclaimed Industrial Oil§f and §bEngine Lubricant§f in the §bIndustrial Mixer§f. At §e130 kTU§f and §e195 kHE§f per bucket, it is a medium-grade fuel for the §bDiesel Generator§f and §bRadial Performance Engine§f.

§6Production§f:
§b•§f §e800mB§f Reclaimed Industrial Oil + §e200mB§f Engine Lubricant → §e1,000mB§f Petroil.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Fuel for Diesel Generator and Radial Performance Engine.
§b•§f Leaded Petroil: §e10,000mB§f + Tetraethyllead → §e12,000mB§f.
§b•§f Solid Fuel: §e13,000mB§f → §e1×§f (Industrial Solidification Machine).
§b•§f Chainsaw fuel, tossable gas cans.

§ePS:§f Petroil has lower energy density than Diesel or Gasoline, but it is made from recycled materials. It works as a stepping stone while you build up to higher-grade fuels!
